refreshPolicy.note: Only feeds with explicit reuse permission and attribution requirements reviewed are enabled.

feeds.name: Telangana State Road Transport Corporation
feeds.notes: Official TGSRTC open-data terms grant a limited worldwide right to use, adapt, reproduce, store, display, copy, transmit and redistribute the data, including in commercial applications, subject to attribution and no implied endorsement. The source states it may update feeds but does not guarantee updates. The currently catalogued URL is a dated snapshot.

feeds.name: Chennai Unified Transit (MTC/Metro/suburban feed)
feeds.notes: Community-maintained feed listed by Mobility Database with a linked terms page, but the producer's rights to redistribute this particular dataset have not yet been confirmed. Disabled pending review; do not publish as an official agency feed.

feeds.name: Pune Mahanagar Parivahan Mahamandal Ltd.
feeds.notes: Community-maintained feed sourced from published PMPML schedule information. Repository dataset license is MIT No Attribution. Not an official PMPML publication; retain UNVERIFIED status until operator/source review. Refresh pipeline validates service dates and GTFS references before artifact publication.
feeds.attribution: PMPML GTFS dataset by Aayush Rai (MIT No Attribution); underlying agency facts are community-transcribed, not operator-certified.

feeds.name: KDMT and BEST (combined community feed)
feeds.notes: Community-maintained combined Mumbai-region bus feed. Repository publishes an MIT license. Agency and route records remain community-derived and unverified; do not label as official. Feed is validated for active service dates and references before publication.
feeds.attribution: BEST/KDMT/TMT GTFS dataset by Aayush Rai (MIT License).

feeds.name: Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation
feeds.notes: Community feed with reported validation errors in the catalog; excluded from automated import pending quality and licence review.

feeds.name: Rajkot Rampath Limited
feeds.notes: Community feed; public catalogue listing is not treated as a redistribution licence.

feeds.name: Ahmedabad Municipal Transit Services / Janmarg
feeds.notes: Community feed; disabled until reuse terms and validation quality are confirmed.

feeds.name: Department of Transport, Government of Goa
feeds.notes: Official feed is explicitly offered to travel-planning apps under CC BY 4.0, but publisher page says last updated 31 Jan 2025. Import is blocked until service calendar is checked and a current service period is confirmed; do not show expired schedules.

feeds.name: Delhi Transport Corporation / Delhi Open Transit Data
feeds.notes: Official portal requires purpose/contact submission to download; published static snapshot last updated 20 Jun 2024 and warns stop times are rough estimates. Realtime endpoint requires an authorised private key. Do not scrape or bypass access controls.

feeds.name: Bangalore Metropolitan Transport Corporation
feeds.notes: Community-maintained archive; catalogue reports old fetch and replacement producer URL. Confirm current feed and licence before import.

feeds.name: Hubli Dharwad Bus Rapid Transit System Company Ltd.
feeds.notes: Community-maintained Hubli-Dharwad BRTS feed sourced from hdbrts.com. Repository publishes an MIT license. Not operator-certified; keep timetable UNVERIFIED pending agency review. Refresh validates service dates and GTFS references.
feeds.attribution: Hubli-Dharwad BRTS GTFS dataset by Aayush Rai (MIT License).

feeds.name: MSRTC Transit
feeds.notes: Community feed contains only 2 routes and service ended 30 Jun 2025. Not suitable as current statewide MSRTC timetable.

feeds.name: Vapi City Bus Service
feeds.notes: Listed in the India GTFS catalogue; exact current producer URL and licence were not independently verified. No import until resolved.

feeds.name: FlixBus India services
feeds.notes: Third-party intercity feed appears in an India feed listing, but a current India-only producer URL and redistribution rights have not been verified.
